correctness.summary: The rook-graph/C4-free correspondence and line-graph identification reduce the problem to a saturation argument: an edge-maximal C4-free bipartite graph cannot have two edge-containing components because a cross-component edge cannot create a C4. Thus every maximal mutual-visibility set is connected and mu_c=mu=z. The pair-count argument proves the explicit large-side regime and the p=4 thin-side values. Exhaustive verification checks six small rook graphs and every maximal set therein.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The full September 2026 connected-mutual-visibility preprint and the full classical Cartesian-product mutual-visibility preprint were inspected. The former contains no rook/Hamming or Cartesian-product theorem; the latter proves mu(K_m square K_n)=z(m,n;2,2) but predates the connected parameter. Exact and synonymous searches found no statement that every maximal mutual-visibility set of a rook graph is connected or the resulting mu_c identity. Older C4-saturation literature may contain the elementary saturation-connectivity observation, for which novelty is not claimed.

value.summary: The result exactly determines the newly introduced connected mutual-visibility number on every two-factor Hamming/rook graph in terms of a classical extremal quantity, proves the stronger automatic-connectivity statement for all maximal mutual-visibility sets, gives exact infinite thin-side regimes, and transfers the square Zarankiewicz problem without loss.

limitations: The general exact value remains as hard as the Zarankiewicz number z(m,n;2,2).
The explicit q+binom(p,2) formula covers only the regime where the elementary pair-count upper bound is tight, apart from the stated p=4 cases.
Higher-dimensional Hamming graphs are not covered.
Bryant--Fu (2002) was not inspected in full text and may contain the elementary C4-saturation connectivity observation; no novelty is claimed for that standalone observation.
Finite computation supports but does not replace the proof.
Independent audit has not been performed.
review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.
